cost.scope: Goal-to-capture includes backlog audit, historical receipt correction, endpoint/trust investigation, resource wait, worktree preparation, capture recipe construction and checks. It is total observed setup elapsed time, not a minimal steady-state rerun cost.

measurement_limits: Each concurrency point is one bounded run with32 requested samples; no repeated-run throughput confidence interval was measured.
P50/P90/P95/P99 are client-visible first content event and end-to-end distributions. Confidence intervals are unmeasured.
The native stream emitted one content event per successful response. Inter-token latency and TPOT are unmeasured.
No saturation or SLA knee is certified. Raw capture summary is retained as a diagnostic and must be read with this qualification.
public_receipt_transformation: Removed only the local absolute artifact path; diagnostic point data and original summary are retained.
public_scrub: No endpoint, hostname, address, credential, absolute path, unrelated arm, or raw internal log is included.
